title: Interfoliaceous
summary: INTERFOLIA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin inter and folium, a leaf.] Being between opposite leaves, but placed alternately with them; as interfoliaceous flowers or peduncles.

inlines.v: INTERFOLIA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin inter and folium, a leaf.] Being between opposite leaves, but placed alternately with them; as interfoliaceous flowers or peduncles.
